primary.usage: Primary brand action color for solid buttons and high-emphasis CTAs.

primaryHover.usage: Hover state for primary text, ghost buttons, and primary action controls.

primaryActive.usage: Pressed state for primary and primary-toned interactive controls.

secondary.usage: Secondary brand accent for toast backgrounds, links, hover text, icons, and progress fills.

tertiary.usage: Tertiary brand accent for features, highlights, and branded elements.

background.usage: Page canvas behind content and design-system guide screens.

surface.usage: Default raised UI surface for cards, modals, popovers, fields, tables, and panels.

surfaceHover.usage: Subtle hover and placeholder surface for rows, upload zones, tags, skeletons, and icon wells.

surfaceActive.usage: Selected or active surface state for menus, pagination, upload icons, and compact status chips.

surfaceMuted.usage: Low-emphasis neutral surface for image wells, table headers, and secondary content panels.

disabled.usage: Disabled control backgrounds and inactive form surfaces.

tooltip.usage: Dark informational surface for tooltips and inverse brand asset previews.

foregroundTitle.usage: Primary heading, selected navigation, important labels, and high-emphasis UI text.

foregroundTitleSubtle.usage: Default navigation/menu text, neutral button text, and secondary title-level labels.

foregroundBody.usage: Default paragraph text and filled form/select values.

foregroundMuted.usage: Helper text, descriptions, captions, metadata, timestamps, and placeholder-adjacent copy.

foregroundDisabled.usage: Text, icons, and labels inside disabled controls.

foregroundAccent.usage: Accent text and legacy progress fills; prefer secondary for new brand-blue UI accents.

foregroundOnDark.usage: Text and icons on dark or saturated surfaces, including primary, secondary, tooltip, destructive, success, and info.

border.usage: Default borders for cards, panels, tables, dividers, and neutral outline buttons.

borderInput.usage: Resting border for text inputs, selects, textareas, checkboxes, and radio controls.

borderFocus.usage: Focus rings, highlighted field borders, and focused/hovered neutral outline borders.

borderError.usage: Validation error borders on fields and controls.

destructive.usage: Destructive actions, delete buttons, error text, and danger-state icons.

destructiveHover.usage: Hover state for solid destructive controls.

destructiveActive.usage: Pressed and outline-hover state for destructive controls.

destructiveSubtle.usage: Subtle destructive backgrounds for validation fields, badges, and danger alerts.

warning.usage: Warning accent color for caution states and pending indicators.

warningSubtle.usage: Subtle warning backgrounds for warning alerts and badges.

warningForeground.usage: Readable text and icons on yellow warning surfaces.

success.usage: Success text, icons, positive trends, and confirmation states.

successSubtle.usage: Subtle success backgrounds for alerts, badges, and positive status surfaces.

info.usage: Informational accent color for tips, notices, and neutral status icons.

infoSubtle.usage: Subtle info backgrounds for info alerts and badges.

iconography.description: Lucide outline icons, stroke rules, and size scale used in UI.
iconography.pageIntro: Lucide outline icons sized to match atoms and molecules. Prefer round stroke caps and joins so icons stay crisp at small sizes.

inputs.pageIntro: Form molecules combine labels, controls, and helper text. States include default, highlighted, prefilled, disabled, and error.

lists.description: Image-led rows with title, description, and trailing actions.
lists.pageIntro: Structured rows for compact content previews, search results, product rows, and asset pickers.

loadersAndSkeletons.title: Loaders & skeletons
loadersAndSkeletons.description: Spinners, loading rows, and placeholder layouts for async states.
loadersAndSkeletons.pageIntro: Loading indicators and placeholder states for asynchronous UI.

molecules.title: Molecules
molecules.description: Composed UI patterns built from atoms for product surfaces.
molecules.pageIntro: Molecules combine atoms into reusable patterns. Start here when a product need is more than a single primitive but not yet a full composite.

navigation.title: Navigation
navigation.description: Tabbed navigation and breadcrumbs for page and section context.
navigation.pageIntro: Tabbed navigation and breadcrumbs for local section switching and hierarchical page context.

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.description: Page controls with default, ellipsis, and compact variants.
pagination.pageIntro: Controls for moving through large result sets, tables, and paged content.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Determinate and indeterminate indicators for ongoing work.
progress.pageIntro: Determinate and indeterminate indicators for uploads, setup flows, and background work.

tablesAndRows.title: Tables & rows
tablesAndRows.description: Column headers, row dividers, cell variants, and dense layouts.
tablesAndRows.pageIntro: Row density, column headers, alignment for data-heavy screens, component matrices, and timestamp formatting patterns.

home.title: Design system guide
home.intro: Use this guide as the source of truth for building consistent Expeerly interfaces. Start with the tokens, then compose UI from the documented atoms, molecules, and composites before adding anything new.
home.foundationsBody: Check typography, color, and style tokens before choosing component styles.
home.componentsBody: Prefer documented atoms, molecules, and composites over one-off UI patterns.
home.extendBody: Add a new token or component only when a repeated product need is not covered here.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.intro: Accessibility rules for using and extending the design system.

keyboard.title: Keyboard behavior
keyboard.description: Every interactive component must be reachable with Tab, usable with Enter or Space where expected, and dismissible with Escape for temporary overlays.

focus.title: Focus states
focus.description: Use the shared focus ring token on all interactive controls. Do not remove focus outlines unless an equivalent visible focus state is present.

contrast.title: Contrast expectations
contrast.description: Normal text should meet at least 4.5:1 contrast. Large text and non-text UI indicators should meet at least 3:1.

disabled.title: Disabled states
disabled.description: Disabled controls should look inactive and must not be the only way to communicate important information. Pair disabled states with helper text when needed.

iconOnly.title: Icon-only controls
iconOnly.description: Icon-only buttons require an aria-label that describes the action, such as Close dialog, Previous page, or Open calendar.

motion.title: Motion and loading
motion.description: Keep animations short and purposeful. Loading states should preserve layout, announce progress when possible, and avoid blocking unrelated page content.

styles.heading: Styles
styles.intro: Border and elevation building blocks used across surfaces, popovers, and tables.

common.hintChooseRange: Choose a start and end date.
common.hintValidDateRange: Please choose a valid date range.
common.hintOneImage: Use this for one image, logo, or document.
common.hintMultipleFiles: Use this when several images or documents can be added.
common.hintUploadProgress: Shows upload progress while files are processing.

accordions.largeIntro: Use the large size for content-heavy sections with longer labels and descriptions.
accordions.smallIntro: Use the small size for filters, settings, and compact supporting panels.
accordions.extraSmallIntro: Use the extra-small size for lightweight disclosures without surrounding lines.

largeOverview.title: What makes this campaign ready to launch?
largeOverview.content: Large accordions are useful for FAQ sections, onboarding content, or review flows where each item needs room for supporting copy.

largeAssets.title: Which assets are required?
largeAssets.content: Include product imagery, review guidance, audience details, and any brand requirements before inviting reviewers.

largeReporting.title: How will reporting be shared?
largeReporting.content: Use the expanded panel for explanatory text, links, or next steps that would be too long for a compact row.

smallFilters.title: Filters
smallFilters.content: Compact accordions work well in sidebars and dense settings panels.

smallStatus.title: Status
smallStatus.content: Keep small accordion content short so the layout stays easy to scan.

extraSmallDetails.title: More details
extraSmallDetails.content: Extra-small accordions are plain text disclosures with no surrounding lines.

extraSmallGuidance.title: View guidance
extraSmallGuidance.content: Use them for compact helper content where a full accordion container would feel too heavy.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: Primary Expeerly logo for white or transparent backgrounds.

inverseLogo.title: Inverse logo
inverseLogo.description: Negative logo for dark or high-contrast surfaces.

logoSymbol.title: Logo symbol
logoSymbol.description: Standalone brand symbol for compact placements.

favicon.title: Favicon
favicon.description: Small app icon treatment based on the compact brand symbol.

assets.moleculesIntro: Reusable composed patterns used across product surfaces, starting with the star rating molecule for review scores.

starRating.defaultIntro: Standard star row with numeric score for review summaries and product detail.
starRating.largeIntro: Larger stars and score text for prominent rating placement on review pages.
starRating.starsOnlyIntro: Hide the numeric score when space is tight or the rating is decorative.
starRating.onDarkIntro: Use on video overlays and other dark surfaces with on-dark foreground tokens.

badgesAndTags.useBadgesForBody: Status, category, tier, or metadata that is not directly editable in place.
badgesAndTags.useTagsForBody: Removable labels, applied filters, and user-managed metadata that needs a clear remove action.
badgesAndTags.avatarIntro: Image and fallback variants of the avatar atom.
badgesAndTags.badgesIntro: Compact status labels; optional leading icon.
badgesAndTags.tagsIntro: Removable labels based on the default badge treatment.

buttons.introLead: Hover and click to see interactive feedback states. All sized variants share the same size scale (large / medium / small). Pass

buttonMatrix.withIconsIntro: Any sized variant accepts an optional iconLeft or iconRight.
buttonMatrix.iconOnlyIntro: Square button, no text label. aria-label required.
buttonMatrix.statesIntro: Hover state is interactive — mouse over the variants above to see it.

cards.raisedSurfaceDescription: Default content container: rounded-lg, border-border, bg-surface, comfortable padding, optional shadow-sm.
cards.mutedPanelDescription: Muted band using bg-background with the same radius and border treatment as raised surfaces.
cards.secondaryPromoIntro: Brand-blue surface for marketing CTAs: surface="secondary" (bg-secondary, border-0, shadow-sm). Pair CardTitle variant="heading-2" with tone="on-dark" for titles on dark backgrounds.
cards.secondaryPromoCardBody: Reach shoppers with authentic video reviews on Expeerly. Use for hub promos, brand CTAs, and other high-visibility marketing blocks.
cards.commonTypesIntro: Frequently reused content structures built from existing atoms and semantic tokens.
cards.iconTextBody: Use for compact feature summaries, metrics, or settings entry points.
cards.badgeCardBody: Use a Badge atom for status, tier, or review state metadata.
cards.settingsCardBody: Group a few related preferences with clear labels and helper text.
cards.emailNotificationsHint: Send updates when reviews need attention.
cards.autoTagHint: Apply verified metadata after product matching.
cards.infoCardBody: Use for guidance, summaries, or supporting copy that should sit inside a standard card.
cards.infoBullet2: Use the same card padding and border treatment as other cards.
cards.imageTextVerticalBody: Stack the image above text for narrow cards, catalog cards, or mobile-first layouts.
cards.imageTextHorizontalBody: Pair a visual region with title, description, and metadata for product, campaign, or review-summary cards.
cards.interactiveIntro: Use an interactive card when the entire surface navigates to one destination. Avoid placing separate buttons or nested links inside a clickable card. Use a standard content card when the surface itself should not navigate.
cards.componentOverviewBody: This is the same clickable card pattern used on the component overview page.
cards.contentCardsIntro: Use content cards when the card needs a title and structured supporting content.
cards.contentCardBody: Use a content card for concise editorial content, summaries, or detail blocks that need a title and supporting body content.
cards.contentBullet1: Body content can be a short paragraph, a bulleted list, or a small group of related details.
cards.contentBullet2: Keep the content focused and use spacing to separate body copy from metadata or actions.
cards.reviewSummaryBody: Highlight a primary message, insight, or product recommendation.
cards.nextStepBody: Pair the summary with supporting guidance or a secondary detail.
cards.audienceBody: Show who the content is for or where it applies.
cards.statusBody: Add a short operational detail or current state.
cards.outcomeBody: Close with the value, result, or action supported by the card.
cards.dataCardsIntro: Compact stat cards pair a secondary value with a label. Use the optional footer slot for reviewer avatars, star ratings, or product thumbnails.

carousels.multiItemIntro: Shows several cards side by side on larger screens. Swipe or horizontally scroll to reveal more.
carousels.compactIntro: Shows one item at a time for compact placements, mobile previews, or focused promos.
carousels.landingEdgeIntro: Right-edge fade treatment with a single overlay next button for mobile-forward carousels.

reviewedProduct.title: Reviewed product
reviewedProduct.description: Feature a verified product, review summary, or campaign story.

brandAsset.title: Brand asset
brandAsset.description: Use carousel cards for logo assets, launch visuals, and product highlights.

inverseMark.title: Inverse mark
inverseMark.description: Show alternate treatments for dark surfaces or high-contrast contexts.

symbol.title: Symbol
symbol.description: Compact artwork works well when paired with concise supporting copy.

starAsset.title: Star asset
starAsset.description: Small icon-led items can represent ratings, favorites, or review quality.

colorTokens.title: Color tokens
colorTokens.intro: Semantic tokens are defined in globals.css and wired in tailwind.config.mjs. The legacy palette remains below for reference.

dialogWindows.useDialogsForBody: Blocking decisions, confirmations, destructive actions, success confirmations, and focused tasks that need explicit completion or dismissal.
dialogWindows.usePopoversForBody: Lightweight contextual controls or supporting information that should not interrupt the page flow.
dialogWindows.dialogsIntro: Centered modal windows for neutral confirmations, success states, destructive decisions, and focused workflows.
dialogWindows.confirmChangesDescription: Review the details before applying this update.
dialogWindows.changesSavedDescription: Your updates have been saved successfully.
dialogWindows.deleteItemDescription: This action cannot be undone. The item and related history will be permanently removed.
dialogWindows.reviewCampaignDescription: A larger dialog gives longer workflows room to breathe while staying responsive on smaller screens.
dialogWindows.campaignSummaryBody: Use a large responsive dialog for review steps, content previews, or settings with supporting context.
dialogWindows.nextActionBody: The close button remains available in the top-right corner for every dialog size.
dialogWindows.smallModalDescription: Use the content className to customize width for compact tasks.
dialogWindows.popoversIntro: Contextual overlays for lightweight supporting content, quick actions, and small controls.
dialogWindows.defaultPopoverBody: Example contextual content for the design system.

emptyStates.defaultIntro: Empty states explain why content is missing and give people a clear next action.
emptyStates.noReviewsDescription: Once customers start sharing reviews, they will appear here for your team to review.
emptyStates.searchIntro: Search empty states should confirm the query found no results and offer a way forward.
emptyStates.noMatchingProductsDescription: Try adjusting your filters or search terms to find what you are looking for.

feedback.useAlertsForBody: Persistent page-level messages, validation summaries, blocked states, and context that should remain visible until resolved.
feedback.useToastsForBody: Short confirmation messages after an action. Do not use toasts for critical errors or content people must read before continuing.
feedback.inPageAlertsIntro: Page-level messages with default, destructive, and warning styles.
feedback.defaultAlertDescription: Use this for neutral guidance that belongs inline with page content.
feedback.destructiveAlertDescription: Use this for errors, blocked states, or destructive consequences.
feedback.warningAlertDescription: Use this for caution states, pending changes, or important pre-submit checks.
feedback.toastsIntro: Short-lived notifications with default, success, and destructive styles plus optional inline actions.
feedback.tooltipsIntro: Brief hover/focus help using the tooltip background and foreground color tokens.
feedback.defaultTooltipContent: Use tooltips for short, non-essential helper text.
feedback.placementTooltipContent: Tooltip content uses bg-tooltip and text-tooltip-foreground.

toastPlayground.destructiveDescription: Try again or contact support if the issue persists.

filtersAndSorting.filterPanelIntro: Use filter panels when people need to narrow a larger collection by status, type, or metadata.
filtersAndSorting.activeCampaignsHint: Hide archived or paused campaigns from the result set.
filtersAndSorting.sortingIntro: Sorting controls should make the active order clear and keep the most common options easy to scan.
filtersAndSorting.appliedFiltersIntro: Applied filters should be visible, removable, and paired with a clear reset action.
filtersAndSorting.singleSelectFilterIntro: A single-select filter uses a dropdown icon before selection, then switches to an X so people can clear the active filter quickly.

inputs.formSpacingIntro: Stack fields in a column with gap-8 (32px) between each control block.
inputs.dateFieldIntro: Custom token-styled calendar popover for single dates and date ranges.
inputs.uploadFieldIntro: Upload fields support click-to-select, drag and drop, and clearing selected files.
inputs.uploadError: Upload a JPG or PNG under 2 MB.
inputs.prefilledDescription: A few sentences of feedback go here.
inputs.subscribeHint: We send a digest once a week.
inputs.publicHint: Anyone with the link can view
inputs.comboboxFieldIntro: Multi-select field: FieldTrigger popover with a searchable checkbox list and removable Tag chips for selected values.

lists.imageListItemIntro: List items combine a leading image or logo, title, description, and a trailing action button.
lists.expeerlyReviewedDescription: A product or brand row with supporting text and a clear action.
lists.brandAssetDescription: Use list items for compact search results, product rows, or asset pickers.

loadersAndSkeletons.loadersIntro: Use loaders when the system is actively working and content is not ready yet.
loadersAndSkeletons.loadingDataBody: Inline loading indicator for short waits.
loadersAndSkeletons.skeletonsIntro: Skeletons reserve layout space while content loads and reduce visual jumping.

navigation.tabbedIntro: Use tabs for peer sections within the same page or surface. The active item uses a primary underline and title text.
navigation.tabbedMenuItemIntro: Use a down caret when tapping a tab opens a menu of related views or filters.
navigation.breadcrumbsIntro: Use breadcrumbs for hierarchical page context. The current page is bold and non-interactive.
navigation.verticalIntro: Use vertical navigation for sidebars or secondary page sections. The active item uses a soft selected surface, and default items use foreground body text.
navigation.verticalMenuItemIntro: Use a right caret when tapping the navigation item opens a menu instead of navigating immediately.
navigation.navigationPatternsBody: Breadcrumbs sit above page context. Tabs sit below the page heading when switching between local views.
navigation.sidebarLayoutBody: Vertical navigation anchors a local sidebar while breadcrumbs preserve page hierarchy.

pagination.usePaginationForBody: Tables, search results, and datasets where people need location, count, and predictable page navigation.
pagination.useInfiniteScrollForBody: Browsing feeds where exact position matters less than continuous discovery.
pagination.defaultIntro: Use page numbers when people need to understand their position in a larger result set.
pagination.ellipsisIntro: Use ellipsis pagination when the total page count is too large to show every page.
pagination.compactIntro: Use compact pagination in tight spaces where previous and next controls are enough.

progress.determinateIntro: Use determinate progress when the system knows how much work is complete.
progress.indeterminateIntro: Use indeterminate progress when the system is working but the remaining time is unknown.
progress.progressCardIntro: Progress can be embedded inside cards for setup flows, uploads, or sync states.
progress.campaignSetupBody: Complete the remaining steps before launch.

styles.bordersIntro: Tailwind border-solid and border-dashed with the border-border token.
styles.elevationIntro: Common shadow utilities paired with rounded-lg and surface background.

tables.denseTableIntro: Column titles use text-body-small font-bold text-foreground-title-subtle with no header fill. Body rows use hover:bg-background and border-b border-border per row.
tables.cellVariantsIntro: Common cell treatments: default left text, avatar with label, Badge atom, muted timestamps, a compact text-right tabular-nums revenue column, and a trailing IconButton (ellipsis) for row actions.
tables.matrixReferenceIntro: Same row and cell pattern as the Buttons page for comparing variants at a glance.

timestampPatterns.title: Timestamps
timestampPatterns.intro: Use <time dateTime="…"> with an ISO-8601 instant. Style with text-body-small, text-foreground-muted, and tabular-nums so digits align in tables. For relative copy, keep dateTime accurate and add aria-label (and optionally title) with the absolute instant so assistive tech and hover tooltips expose the precise moment.
timestampPatterns.absoluteLongWhen: Detail views, audit trails, or when timezone matters—localize strings in product.
timestampPatterns.absoluteCompactWhen: Dense tables and lists; right-align when paired with numeric columns.
timestampPatterns.relativeAriaLabel: Last updated May 12, 2026, at 9:18 AM UTC
timestampPatterns.relativeWhen: Activity feeds; refresh periodically in app code. Never drop dateTime.
timestampPatterns.justNowWhen: Same rules; define a small window (e.g. under one minute) for “Just now” in your copy layer.
timestampPatterns.bulletUtc: Prefer UTC in dateTime and convert for display if you show local time.
timestampPatterns.bulletThrottle: Avoid updating relative strings on every render without throttling—use a sensible interval or event boundaries.

iconography.strokeCapsIntro: Use Lucide (outline set). Prefer strokeLinecap="round", strokeLinejoin="round", and a strokeWidth that steps up on smaller sizes (e.g. 2.5 at 12px — aligned with the Checkbox atom — down to 2 at 16px and above) so strokes stay crisp. Icons inherit currentColor; pair with text-foreground-* tokens.
iconography.opticalSizesIntro: Pick a pixel size first, then align the icon box to adjacent text (usually text-body-small at 16px for inline chrome).
iconography.sizeDenseUsage: Checkbox mark, tight controls (see Checkbox atom).
iconography.sizeDefaultUsage: Buttons (medium/small), fields, tables, IconButton medium, SearchField.
iconography.sizeLargeControlUsage: Primary row actions, IconButton large, button matrix large column.
iconography.sizeDisplayUsage: Marketing or empty states only — avoid in dense app chrome.
iconography.glyphsIntro: Same names as lucide-react imports — all shown at 16px with the outline stroke above.
iconography.retailIntro: Useful Lucide glyphs for product catalogs, shopping flows, fulfillment, purchases, and review experiences. Shown at 16px with the same stroke rules.
iconography.socialIntro: Lucide includes a limited set of social glyphs. Use these for neutral UI previews; production social links should still follow each platform's current brand asset guidance.
